dialog.title: Channel Features
dialog.description: What the primary and secondary channels do and what the channel icons mean.
dialog.secondaryPositionFeature: Disabling position on the primary channel allows periodic position broadcasts on the first secondary channel with the position enabled, otherwise manual position request required.

uplink.label: MQTT Uplink Enabled
uplink.description: Messages from the mesh will be sent to the public internet through any node's configured gateway.

downlink.label: MQTT Downlink Enabled
downlink.description: Messages from a public internet gateway are forwarded to the local mesh. Due to the zero-hop policy, traffic from the default MQTT server will not propagate further than this device.

secure.label: Secure
secure.description: A green lock means the channel is securely encrypted with either a 128 or 256 bit AES key.

insecureNoPrecise.label: Insecure Channel, Not Precise
insecureNoPrecise.description: A yellow open lock means the channel is not securely encrypted, is not used for precise location data, and uses either no key at all or a 1 byte known key.

insecurePreciseOnly.label: Insecure Channel, Precise Location
insecurePreciseOnly.description: A red open lock means the channel is not securely encrypted, is used for precise location data, and uses either no key at all or a 1 byte known key.

insecurePreciseMqtt.label: Warning: Insecure, Precise Location & MQTT Uplink
insecurePreciseMqtt.description: A red open lock with a warning means the channel is not securely encrypted, is used for precise location data which is being uplinked to the internet via MQTT, and uses either no key at all or a 1 byte known key.

editDialog.description: Changes are sent to the radio when you save the settings.

validation.pskInvalid: Please enter a valid {{bits}} bit PSK.

name.label: Channel Name
name.description: Up to 11 bytes. Leave blank to use the default name.

uplinkEnabled.label: MQTT Uplink Enabled
uplinkEnabled.description: Send messages from the local mesh to MQTT

downlinkEnabled.label: MQTT Downlink Enabled
downlinkEnabled.description: Send messages from MQTT to the local mesh

positionEnabled.label: Position enabled
positionEnabled.description: Share this node's position on this channel.

beaconOffers.title: Mesh Beacon offers
beaconOffers.addHint: Joining adds this channel. The radio stays on its current settings.
beaconOffers.switchHint: Joining replaces your primary channel and LoRa settings. The radio retunes and reboots.
